drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 68-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.47, bnp 119, creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 14.2, platelets 295, sodium 139, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 68-73, heart_rate 70-74, map 85-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 117-122, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 60%, normal
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.82, hemoglobin 14.3, platelets 285, sodium 139, wbc 6.6; vitals dbp 68-72, heart_rate 68-74, map 86-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 118-124, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 68-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
